title: X Post
description: A single post for X (旧Twitter) produced by A10-X X Content Agent. Contains the twelve fields specified in the implementation brief, plus the fields this repository requires to enforce agents/sns/x/rules.md at the data-structure level. A post with an empty basis array cannot be emitted (rules.md section 1.1).

id.description: Stable identifier, e.g. X-0042. Carried through QA, approval and analytics so performance is attributable to a production decision.

status.description: blocked = missing basis, visit record, or business fact. rejected = failed a QA gate.

blocked_reason.description: REQUIRED when status is 'blocked'. States exactly what input is missing and who can supply it.

category.description: A = 歴史・日本文化, B = 開運アクションの具体的解説, C = 占い・開運, D = 食・生活と開運. See categories.md. Category is what the post is about; x_tier is how defensible it is.

x_tier.description: positioning.md section 5. X-A = moat (firsthand or practitioner judgment), X-B = authority (sourced history/culture/method), X-C = practice (explained action). X-D is forbidden and is never emitted.

theme.description: The subject the post belongs to. Multiple posts share one theme via different angles.

target.description: Who this post is for and what situation they are in. Not a demographic label.

angle.description: writing.md section 3. 教養型 / 誤解型 / 実践型 / 開運型 / 歴史型 / 問題提起型 / 比較型 / 季節型 / 失敗型 / 質問回答型.

basis.description: positioning.md section 3 — the central constraint. Every post must be traceable to at least one basis. 'mechanism' alone is never sufficient for a post about 運気 (rules.md section 1.2).

visit_record_id.description: REQUIRED when basis includes 'firsthand'. References a completed human visit already recorded in the repository. A firsthand post without this is a rule violation (agents/seo/rules.md section 2).

hook.description: The first one or two lines. Must not use fear framing or promise something the body does not deliver (writing.md section 7). Hooks are in compliance scope.

hook_pattern.description: Recorded so Analytics can segment performance by hook pattern.

hook_candidates.description: writing.md section 7 requires at least three candidates and a recorded reason for the choice.

hook_choice_rationale.description: Why the chosen hook was chosen over the candidates.

body.description: 情報 → 理由 → 現代への置き換え (writing.md section 2). A body with no 理由 section is almost always a Tier X-D post in disguise.

cta.description: The CTA text as it appears in the post. Empty string when cta_type is 'none'.

cta_type.description: writing.md section 8. No type more than twice per batch; 'booking' at most once; roughly half a batch is 'none'.

cta_url.description: REQUIRED when cta_type is 'read_more'. Must be a live URL carrying a UTM tag with this post's id (integrations.md).

hashtags.description: 0–2 tags, default 0. Tier X-D tags (#今日の運勢 #無料占い #タロット #12星座) and outcome tags (#開運確定 #願いが叶う) are forbidden (writing.md section 6).

source_required.description: true when the post makes any claim about history, culture, 暦, 由緒, or food tradition. Always true for category A.

fact_check_required.description: true when any factual_claim is not already 'verified'. Drives emission of x_fact_check_request.

verification_status.description: A post may not ship with an unresolved 'needs_verification' claim (rules.md section 3.7). A 'refuted' claim usually removes the post, not just the sentence.

source_candidates.description: Where the claim could be checked. Required for anything not already verified.

hedge_applied.description: true when the claim is written as 〜と言われています / 諸説あります rather than asserted.

risk_level.description: low = no claim about outcomes, history or health. medium = historical/cultural claims, or 運気 framing needing care. high = touches 金運・健康・人生の判断, or names a specific shrine. 'high' requires an explicit disclaimer decision.

compliance.description: Self-check against rules.md section 2, performed by X Content Agent before QA sees the post. QA is the second gate, not the first.

subjectivity_marked.description: Subjective claims carry 私の見立てでは / 感じています / 考えています (agents/seo/rules.md section 3.1).

hook_checked.description: The hook itself was checked against the above. A compliant body under a fear-framed hook is still a violation.

placeholders.description: Unfilled business facts. The agent never guesses these (rules.md section 5.4). Publication is gated on this array being empty.

thread.description: writing.md section 5. Maximum 5 posts. The first post must work alone — most readers never open the thread.

char_count.description: X-weighted count (全角 = 2, URL = 23), measured AFTER placeholder substitution. Budget is 280 weighted, roughly 140 全角文字.

seasonal_window.description: workflow.md section Seasonal backward planning. Fact-check turnaround is the binding constraint, not writing.

repurpose_candidates.description: Where this content should go next if it performs. Handed to A08 Content Production Agent (outputs.md).

related_posts.description: Other posts from the same theme. Recorded so the batch scheduler can spread them apart; posts must still stand alone.

plan_id.description: The content plan this post was expanded from.

batch.description: Batch the post belongs to, matching content/sns/drafts/<YYYY-MM>/.

then.description: A firsthand post requires a completed visit record (agents/seo/rules.md section 2). Exempt only while status is 'blocked' — a blocked post exists precisely to record that the visit record is what is missing.
Category A (歴史・日本文化) cannot rest on mechanism or practitioner_view alone (categories.md).
Category B requires mechanism PLUS at least one of verified_fact or practitioner_view (categories.md).
Category D pairs the cultural/seasonal fact with a mechanism or the practitioner's view (categories.md).
Tier X-A requires firsthand experience or the practitioner's own judgment (positioning.md section 5).
If a fact check is required, the claims requiring it must be enumerated.
A high-risk post requires an explicit disclaimer decision, not a default.
Approval gate, enforced structurally: no unfilled placeholders, no unresolved claims, every compliance check passed.
